confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel rates, which vary widely by property and season. July is rainy-season low season, so accommodation may sit below peak levels. Cocktail and wine are direct estimates cross-checked against the beer anchor. Visitor prices are usually quoted in USD, although the official currency is KHR. The FX observation came from a search summary of rba.gov.au results rather than a direct page read; verify it against the live RBA page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city comparator used. Regional basis: tourism-driven Southeast Asian towns with a similar visitor economy (for example Luang Prabang, Laos), adjusted for Siem Reap's Angkor-driven hotel demand and its large budget-hostel supply.
